facts.note: At the temple's nine, the husband had everyone show watches; Félix's watch showed twenty minutes to nine; Aurèle scolded him.
Piquet with the doctor in the salon with no break; the temple struck ten during play; they played until he went out for cigars; she did not look at the clock when he went.
He asked her to play as he left (transcript says 'before he left', same sequence); she sat at the piano at once, played until he came back, and stopped when he came in.
A moment after he came back, the hall clock struck eleven.
